item: Field checks get their own Advanced section, with a waiting count and a link beside the Diagnostics button
status: built; Chromium-checked in en and fr
summary: R319 release note: Field checks are easier to find. They were the fourth block inside the folded Diagnostics section; they are now their own section of Settings -> Advanced, right after Diagnostics, and its title shows how many checks for this system have no result yet (for example 14 waiting for this machine). A Field checks link beside the Diagnostics button opens it, and opening the section shows the list at once. Field report 2026-11-09: I can't find the button for the field testing.
